tei:titleStmt.tei:title: אַחֵינוּ הַנְּתוּנִים בְּצָרָה וּבְשִׁבְיָה
Our brethren in distress and bondage, a plea for the safety of Am Yisrael at the conclusion of prayer and ceremonies by Seth (Avi) Kadish

tei:div.tei:head: Our brethren in distress and bondage, a plea for the safety of Am Yisrael at the conclusion of prayer and ceremonies by Seth (Avi) Kadish

tei:l.tei:note: At weddings before breaking the glass,
at the end of Birkat ha-Mazon,
before returning the Torah to the Ark,
or at the end of any group study or prayer.

tei:lg.tei:l: Our brethren, the whole House of Israel, who are in distress and bondage:
Our brethren who stand guard over our land
on the sea and in the air and on the ground,
Our brethren in combat on the battlefield,
And all members of our people (held in captivity)
And those threatened by malice in our land and in exile,
And all those in need of Your comfort —
May the Omnipresent֑֭דפשמ֖ have mercy on them and lead them from distress to relief,

tei:l.j:divineName: from darkness to light and from bondage to redemption,
